name: Collier County Public Schools
districtFact: Collier County Public Schools serves Naples, Marco Island, Golden Gate, Immokalee, Ave Maria, and Everglades-area communities where school-year planning is shaped by winter resort season, hurricane risk, agricultural work cycles, multilingual households, and long countywide travel distances.

about.title: About Collier County Public Schools
about.content: Collier County Public Schools is the countywide public school district for Collier County, Florida. The district serves coastal communities such as Naples and Marco Island, inland growth areas such as Golden Gate and Ave Maria, agricultural communities such as Immokalee, and smaller Everglades-area communities. Its academic calendars list teacher start, student start, holidays, teacher planning days, professional learning days, early dismissal days, interim and report card dates, FTE periods, Fall Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, graduation week, and the last student and teacher days.

about.title: Why the Collier Calendar Needs Local Context
about.content: Collier County does not run on one household schedule. Naples and Marco Island follow a winter resort rhythm, with seasonal residents, tourism, hospitality staffing, and peak traffic from roughly November through April. Immokalee and inland communities have a different planning cycle tied to agriculture, long bus routes, agricultural work schedules, and seasonal employment patterns that do not always align with school holidays. Families should verify emergency schedule changes during hurricane season, while Spring Break and late-May early dismissal dates often affect travel, childcare, and seasonal employment at the same time. Collier's multilingual calendar publications also matter: the district publishes English, Spanish, and Creole versions when available.

planningTips.title: Planning Tips for Collier County Families
content: Check whether you need the English, Spanish, or Creole calendar. Collier publishes multilingual calendar PDFs for 2026-2027.
Plan childcare early for Fall Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, teacher plan days, and professional learning days because those breaks overlap with Naples and Marco Island's busy tourism season.
Families in Immokalee, Ave Maria, Golden Gate Estates, and Everglades communities should account for longer travel distances and bus timing when early dismissal days are listed.
Before booking late-May travel, verify whether hurricane closures or district announcements changed the final student day or teacher planning schedule.
Watch the district note for no CCPS activities after sundown on selected dates when planning school events, athletics, or evening activities.

customSections.label: Collier School Calendar by Community
customSections.content: Families often search by local community, but the main academic calendar is published districtwide by Collier County Public Schools. Naples, Marco Island, Golden Gate, North Naples, East Naples, Immokalee, Ave Maria, Everglades City, and surrounding communities use the CCPS academic calendar unless a specific school, program, athletics team, or event publishes separate details.

customSections.label: Collier Planning Notes for Families
customSections.content: Collier's calendar carries planning details that are easy to miss in a generic holiday list. It identifies FTE periods, interim dates, early dismissal and professional learning days, teacher plan days, graduation week, multilingual calendar versions, and local notes about CCPS activities after sundown. Those details are especially useful for families coordinating school with seasonal resort work, agriculture, tourism, and long cross-county commutes.

groups.label: Southwest Florida timing
items: Winter resort season overlaps most of the school year in Naples and Marco Island.
Spring Break and graduation week can collide with peak seasonal work and travel demand.
Emergency schedule changes during hurricane season should be verified directly with CCPS before relying on school-year or late-May travel plans.

groups.label: Community-specific planning
items: Immokalee and inland families may need more lead time for transportation and childcare on early dismissal days.
Marco Island and coastal Naples families should plan around resort traffic during major school breaks.
Multilingual households can use the district's Spanish and Creole PDFs when available.

districtFaqs.q: What school district serves Naples, Florida?
districtFaqs.a: Naples public schools are served by Collier County Public Schools. The districtwide calendar applies to Naples schools, while individual campuses may publish separate events, athletics, testing, and graduation details.

districtFaqs.q: Does Collier County Public Schools include Marco Island and Immokalee?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. Collier County Public Schools serves Marco Island, Immokalee, Naples, Golden Gate, Ave Maria, and other Collier County communities.

districtFaqs.q: Does Collier publish Spanish or Creole school calendars?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. For 2026-2027, Collier County Public Schools publishes Spanish and Creole academic calendar PDFs in addition to the English calendar.

districtFaqs.q: What is Fall Break on the Collier school calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Collier County Public Schools lists a full Fall Break week around Thanksgiving. It is separate from Winter Break and Spring Break and is one of the major childcare and travel planning windows for families.

districtFaqs.q: How does hurricane season affect the Collier school calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Collier County may close schools during tropical storms or hurricanes. Families should verify late changes with the official CCPS calendar page and district announcements before making nonrefundable plans around the end of the school year.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Collier calendar changes?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Collier County Public Schools calendar page and campus announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates summarizes official calendar documents and is not affiliated with CCPS.

districtFaqs.q: Do Naples schools use the Collier County school calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. Public schools in Naples generally use the districtwide Collier County Public Schools academic calendar, while individual campuses may publish separate events, testing, athletics, and graduation details.

districtFaqs.q: Do Immokalee schools have different school holidays?
districtFaqs.a: Most Immokalee public schools follow the CCPS districtwide academic calendar. Families should still verify school-specific programs, transportation notes, and campus events with their assigned school.

districtFaqs.q: Are Collier County school calendars different by school type?
districtFaqs.a: The main CCPS academic calendar applies districtwide, but specialized programs, charter schools, athletics, graduation events, testing windows, and campus activities may publish separate schedules.
